{{Quote|Oh, dear, it's been a never-ending series of calamities today. Just before you got here, we sent out another adventurer to look for the lost tour group. Please go and find him.|Rovim Minnoni|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Nion Lip'to''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Rovim Minnoni]] tasked Lip'to with finding a lost tour group from [[Duzay]] near the retreat of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. However, when he himself got lost in his attempt to find them, Minnoni tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding him.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NionLiptoJapanese.jpg|250px|thumb|Known, randomly generated depiction of Nion Lip'to from one of the two Japanese servers]]
Nion Lip'to was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Nion Lip'to spawned under a generic template, his appearance was randomized. A known screenshot of Lip'to exists, depicting him as a randomly generated [[Human/Legends|Human]] male under the "commoner_naboo_human_male_06" Interchange File Format.<ref name="AED" /> However, because the game files do not include the exact template used for Lip'to, it cannot be concluded that he always spawned as a Human.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> Furthermore, it should be noted that the known screenshot of Lip'to was taken from one of two defunct Japanese servers, which used different character templates for some of its NPCs. In any case, while the [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]] of Lip'to cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Lip'to as male. The questline that involved Lip'to was removed from the game sometime after launch.<ref name="AED" />
